references.text: Also describes the border toward Mehetabel, the same boundary marker mentioned in Manasseh's border description
Continues the description of the Tappuah area mentioned in verse 7, and clarifies the relationship between the territories of Manasseh and Ephraim
Mentions the king of Tappuah who was defeated, the same city referred to in the border description
The first time Shechem is mentioned, the important place that Manasseh's border passes by
Jacob comes to Shechem and buys land there, the same geographical area that Manasseh's border passes through
